integrity: The proof is integral and uses Riemann–Roch, explicit generators of the numerical Grothendieck group, unimodular row/column operations, and Hodge index. The packaged verifier checks the matrix reduction and Smith factors on exact integer examples; the infinite-rank-uniform statement rests on the symbolic proof rather than finite testing.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to smooth projective surfaces and does not provide an analogous integral decomposition in higher dimension. The originality comparison found closely related surface-pseudolattice literature, so an unindexed prior statement of the same elementary reduction remains a residual risk.
title: The numerical Euler lattice of a surface has the Néron–Severi discriminant group
